lede: The web didn't converge today. Across 17 sources there were 17 separate conversations, and not one topic crossed feeds. The single loudest signal sat on Wikipedia, where Barry Melrose drew 238,858 views, just ahead of Drew Lock. GitHub's fastest riser was a coding-agent tool called i-have-adhd, up 3,882 stars in a day, and on Steam the crowd went where it usually does, to Counter-Strike 2.
